states.content: Cardioversion remains the plan for Marcus Reed's atrial fibrillation rhythm control. Because the timing of his Monday-night apixaban dose is uncertain, Dr. Patel is changing the approach from direct cardioversion to TEE-guided cardioversion so a clot can be checked for first while still avoiding an unnecessary delay. Dr. Patel is proceeding with TEE-guided cardioversion today; the TEE is to confirm there is no clot before the shock. Dr. Patel confirms that if the TEE is clear, the cardioversion will proceed immediately today. The Wednesday, March 11 slot was released, and the Thursday, March 12 slot was taken by an add-on case; the TEE-guided cardioversion is now scheduled for Friday, March 13 at 12:30 PM with 11:00 AM arrival at the cardiac procedures unit on the third floor. Reception Ana has reconfirmed the Friday arrival: March 13, 11:00 AM, cardiac procedures unit, third floor. Scheduler Terry has updated the arrival letter in the portal, and Marcus's own portal copy prep line now says TEE-guided cardioversion. Marcus requests that the procedure slot details be put in the chart. Dr. Patel has reviewed the labs and stated they are acceptable for outpatient cardioversion, satisfying the pending-labs condition; full medication history reconciliation remains part of the plan. Dr. Patel instructs that Marcus must not miss any apixaban doses at all between now and cardioversion, and to continue apixaban exactly as prescribed without missing any further doses. Pharmacist Klein confirms apixaban stays at 5 mg twice daily and Marcus must not stop or skip it on his own unless the cardiologist specifically says otherwise. The only routine periprocedural hold discussed is lisinopril on the morning of the procedure once the date is confirmed. Nurse Jamison will bring Marcus back first for his cardiology rhythm clinic visit. Post-procedure follow-up note entered: Monday, March 16 nurse callback at 8:40 AM; Tuesday, March 17 ECG at 11:00 AM followed by a Dr. Patel visit at 11:30 AM in Suite 4C. Marcus has said these follow-up times work for him right now and asked that they be kept in the portal.
